mapper.select: WITH funds AS () SELECT orders.order_count,orders.order_payable,confirmed.paid_order_count,confirmed.normal_receipt, confirmed.abnormal_receipt,confirmed.normal_refund,confirmed.abnormal_refund FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count,COALESCE(SUM(payable_amount),0) AS order_payable FROM tc_order WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND currency=#{currency} AND created_at >= #{q.createdFrom} AND created_at < #{q.createdTo} ) orders CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN kind='NORMAL_RECEIPT' THEN 1 END) AS paid_order_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN kind='NORMAL_RECEIPT' THEN amount END),0) AS normal_receipt, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN kind='ABNORMAL_RECEIPT' THEN amount END),0) AS abnormal_receipt, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN kind='NORMAL_REFUND' THEN amount END),0) AS normal_refund, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN kind='ABNORMAL_REFUND' THEN amount END),0) AS abnormal_refund FROM funds ) confirmed
